spec.assertion: Borrow-buff firing frames == floor(guilty pull count / 6) ±1. Fails under the nearest-wrong per-PELLET hit count (guilty is SG, hitsPerShot 10 → ~10x firings) and under a per-pull shotFired trigger (~6x). Non-vacuity: pulls > 0 and expected firings > 0.

spec.kitLine: Duplicates 8.81% of ATK of highest ally
spec.assertion: Emitted buffApply value is a single FLAT number and is NOT 8.81 (fails under a plain atkPct encoding that scales guilty's own ATK by 8.81%); doubling the authored percentage exactly doubles the flat value (fails under a hardcoded literal); shipped value >= the same effect re-scaled to guilty's OWN ATK (fails under a mis-ranked target such as a support or lowest-ATK pick). ⚑ Equality is legal and means guilty is the team ATK max — includes-self vs excludes-self is NOT derivable from the log, flagged not guessed.

maxStacks on every borrow buffApply == 5 and observed stacks never exceed 5. Fails under a cap of 6 (which would mean the S2 stack-count line was silently folded in) — flagged as an interpretation fork tied to G2, not asserted as a defect.
expiresFrame - frame == 600 on every application (wall-clock seconds). Fails under a durationShots/round-count encoding (expiresFrame null) or a permanent buff.
targetIdx of every borrow application == guilty's slot only. Fails under an allies/alliesTopAtk scoping that would hand the borrowed ATK to teammates.
4.13% atkPct firing frames == floor(pull count / 12) ±1 — exactly half the S1 cadence, again excluding per-pellet and per-pull readings.

spec.kitLine: Increases stack count of buffs by 1
spec.assertion: it.skip — no primitive exists: a buff declares its own maxStacks and nothing can raise another buff's stack count or cap, cross-unit or otherwise. The only in-kit consumer is guilty's own 5-stack borrow buff; G1 asserts the kit-literal 5 and flags the alternative (authoring the cap at 6) rather than picking it silently.
buffApply stat atkPct value exactly 4.13 (a plain target-scaled percentage, NOT a flat caster-scaled add) with expiresFrame - frame == 600.

Holder set is a STRICT SUBSET of the 4-unit comp and CONTAINS guilty (she is Wind, so an excludeSelf scoping fails). The {kind:'allies'} counterfactual must reach all 4 slots AND change at least one teammate's total — proving the scoping assertion is one the unscoped model provably fails, not a no-op.

Exactly one 284.32% damage event per guilty burstCast, bucket 'burst', and fbMajorApplied never true — a burst CAST resolves before the Full Burst window opens, so an FB-major-taking encoding fails. Non-vacuity: burst casts > 0 is asserted explicitly (the fixture was chosen to guarantee it).

it.skip — single boss, and resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) has no entity to rank, so the selection clause is trivially satisfied and unobservable. One-hit-per-cast is already pinned by the 284.32% group.

spec.kitLine: when Borrow is at max stacks
spec.assertion: The gate is the whole claim, tested with an explicit both-cases fork. If peak observed borrow stacks < 5 (expected: an SG accrues a stack per 6 pulls while each lives 10s, so ~2 concurrent) the 277.71% rider must fire ZERO times; if >= 5 every firing frame must lie inside a live 5-stack window. The ungated counterfactual then fires it once per cast, which is what proves a shipped zero comes from the GATE and not from a dropped block (the patch throws loudly if neither branch effect exists anywhere in the burst slot).

Structural: a 20.25-magnitude buff effect exists in the burst slot with durationSec 5 on an enemy-targeted block (no silent drop). Behavioural inertness: no ally ever holds a 20.25 buff from guilty, and any boss-held emission (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) carries a 300-frame window. ⚑ FLAGGED: asserted NOT to be damageTakenPct — boss DEF is subtracted per hit, so a 20.25% DEF cut is not a 20.25% damage increase; if the repo deliberately approximates it that way, this is a divergence to adjudicate, not a blind fix.

Structural presence at exactly 277.71% flatDamage with core not true (riders get no core unless the text says core strike damage). Ungated, it lands once per cast, never takes the FB major, and raises ONLY guilty's total — every teammate byte-identical (inertness).

fixtures: Deliberate deviation from controlComp('guilty'): guilty is BURST II and controlComp hardcodes crown, also Burst II with the same 20s cooldown, so the standard comp pits two stage-2 casters against each other and can starve guilty of burst casts entirely — that would make the three burst groups silently VACUOUS. Fixture used instead: slugs ['liter' (B1), 'guilty' (B2, sole stage-2 caster), 'ada' (B3), 'helm' (B3)], bossElement 'Fire', focusSlug 'guilty' — same scope-lock basis and boss element as controlComp, with two Burst III units at <=40s cd so stage 3 is covered every rotation (stageCovered) and the chain actually runs. Deterministic (no seed). 5 hoisted runs: base, S1 percentage doubled, S1 re-scaled to own ATK, S2 widened to all allies, burst max-stack branch ungated. Every burst group asserts burst casts > 0 before reading anything.
gaps: skill2 'Increases stack count of stackable buffs by 1' — it.skip: no primitive can raise another buff's stack count or cap (maxStacks is declared per-effect, and there is no cross-buff/cross-unit stack channel). Only reachable in-kit consumer is guilty's own 5-stack borrow buff; the live fork is 'leave the cap at 5 + record unmodeled' vs 'author the cap at 6'. G1 asserts the kit-literal 5 and flags the fork.
burst 'Affects the 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF' — it.skip: one boss and no enemy entity to rank, so the selection clause is trivially satisfied and unobservable in v1.

burst 'DEF ▼ 20.25%' behavioural magnitude — the enemy has no modeled DEF pool that a debuff event can be read against, so only structural presence, the 5s window, and ally-inertness are assertable; whether the engine has a faithful enemy-DEF channel at all is outside what the kit prose can tell me (⚑ flagged, and the damageTakenPct substitution is asserted against rather than assumed).

skill1 'the ally with the highest ATK' — whether 'ally' includes self, and which unit is the team ATK maximum, is not derivable from the event log; the test asserts the direction-safe floor (shipped >= own-ATK-scaled) and flags that equality is ambiguous instead of guessing a magnitude.
